title: Aerospace company's government customers on the program (CIA, Air Force)

tellings.quote: do know from the um Aerospace company that I interacted with quite frequently during the assap they did go to the government customer it wasn't always a CIA it was Air Force at times

plain: An aerospace company that worked on a secret program reported to a government customer, and that customer was not always the CIA: sometimes it was the Air Force. A researcher named Eric W. Davis says he heard this from the company itself, which he dealt with often during a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained aerial phenomena, and he tells it to show which agencies were behind such work.
